text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 20, 2024) for 51-67 Waterford Drive.

The Property Standards Committee - Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 20, 2024) for 51-67 Waterford Drive, Folder Number 24 199988 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to September 30, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
